summary: Primary Polish supplier catalog observations for purchased specimens. Stock availability, actual crown density, logistics and final quotes need confirmation. These are not mature-size or installed-price estimates.
taxNote: Galeria Ogrodowa sales terms state displayed PLN prices include VAT. Fischer and Wyplatane amounts are recorded as displayed; a VAT statement was not located on the inspected product pages. Do not apply a blanket VAT conversion to all sources.

plantSuitability.title: RHS — Austrian pine
plantSuitability.note: Evergreen, full sun, well-drained soil, H7. Mature height can exceed 12 m and spread 8 m; purchased dimensions are modelled separately.

plantSuitability.title: RHS — plants for coastal gardens
plantSuitability.note: Austrian pine is among coastal recommendations. Wind, salt exposure, soil and drainage still require site-specific selection.

plantSuitability.title: RHS — Serbian spruce
plantSuitability.note: Narrow conical evergreen, H7, full sun and moist well-drained soil; shelter from cold drying winds. Mature spread about 2.5–4 m and height above 12 m.

plantSuitability.title: RHS — hornbeam
plantSuitability.note: Deciduous, H7, sun or partial shade, moist well-drained or well-drained soil. Leaf-off screening is not an opaque summer canopy.

plantSuitability.title: RHS — choosing hedges
plantSuitability.note: Hornbeam can retain some winter leaves, less than beech; this does not establish guaranteed opaque winter screening.

modelAssumptions.dimensions: Midpoints initialize purchased size bands. Ordinary-tree crown bases are drawing assumptions; quoted diameter initializes both crown width and depth. Panel clear-stem height and height/width are documented; its depth is an editable 0.4 m drawing assumption.
modelAssumptions.priceLimits: Automatic pricing requires dimensions within the selected purchased-stock ranges. No height or width extrapolation. For ordinary crowns, depth must fit the diameter band. Panel depth is not a supplier measurement: increasing it above the 0.4 m drawing default requires a custom quote; this limit is a conservative budgeting rule, not a verified stock range. The documented panel stem and height/width remain fixed. A custom plant-only unit price can cover an independently quoted specimen.
modelAssumptions.services: Planting, anchoring, delivery, crane/unloading and establishment are separate editable allowances. Zero means unquoted when applicable. Published-stock Wyplatane delivery is included; a catalog pleached-only order receives no extra delivery or automatic crane allowance. Custom plant-only quotes do not inherit supplier delivery. Enlarging panel height, width or assumed depth also requires an unloading allowance because handling for the changed specimen is unverified.
modelAssumptions.quantity: Only enabled trees enter the screening-tree budget. A catalog of an individual specimen does not guarantee multiple matching trees at the same price.
modelAssumptions.privacy: Geometric crown envelopes are optimistic approximations. Branch gaps, density and seasonal leaf loss prevent a guaranteed 100 percent real-world privacy claim.
modelAssumptions.growth: These are purchased-stock dimensions. No unverified growth curve, mature-size discount or maintenance cost forecast is used.
modelAssumptions.climate: RHS hardiness and exposure profiles support species selection but are not a guarantee for an individual coastal Gdansk site or transplanted specimen.
